head: a66b1c857ff25e2c4b653be863cfcbb55e898785
app: the web build of this head, served over http from the dist dir
capture: an X11 grab of the app's canvas at exactly 1280x720, cropped only the browser's infobar above the app; the real X pointer is drawn in
input: the app's own control channel (the one the scenarios and the MCP bridge use): ui.handles to find a widget by name, ui.click to press it, ui.camera to pose the view

scene.body: one plate, 40 x 30 x 10 mm, its corner at the model's origin
scene.camera: orthographic (1:1 mm), looking down on the plate from its middle

pictures.what: the DXF export dialog open, with the new 'Zero point' option visible ('Camera target' selected)
the same dialog with 'Model origin' chosen

shows: the DXF export dialog, with the new 'Zero point' choice between 'Camera target' and 'Model origin' and the line that says where the drawing's 0,0 is

measurement.what: the drawing's extents in the DXF the app itself exports, read back from the app's export command (file.export_view_dxf)
measurement.plate: 40 x 30 mm, its corner at the model's origin (0,0,0)

zero_target.meaning: the camera target is the drawing's 0,0

zero_origin.meaning: the model's origin is the drawing's 0,0

read_by: the smallest and largest x and y of every point in the DXF's ENTITIES section
